reasons.c.integration: c/Makefile's test-integration and rust/Makefile's test-integration-grpc-c now go through selected-run and selected-cargo-test with the c.integration section.
reasons.c.unit: c/Makefile's test-unit now runs ctest through selected-run with --ctest name filtering.
reasons.dotnet.grpc: dotnet/Makefile's gRPC image build and rust/Makefile's test-integration-grpc-dotnet now go through the selection wrappers.
reasons.dotnet.performance: dotnet/Makefile's perf-unit-test-dotnet and test-integration-perf-dotnet lines are now wrapped in selected-run, including the moved env variable.
reasons.dotnet.soak: dotnet/Makefile's test-soak-dotnet lines are now wrapped in selected-run.
reasons.dotnet.solution: dotnet/Makefile's test-dotnet lines now go through selected-run with --dotnet filter building that combines with DOTNET_TEST_FILTER.
reasons.python.grpc: python/Makefile's gRPC image build and rust/Makefile's test-integration-grpc-python now go through the selection wrappers.
reasons.python.integration: python/Makefile's integration pytest line now goes through selected-run.
reasons.python.performance: python/Makefile's test-performance recipe is now wrapped in selected-run.
reasons.python.soak: python/Makefile's test-soak recipe is now wrapped in selected-run.
reasons.python.static: python/Makefile's check-static recipe is now wrapped in selected-run.
reasons.python.typecheck: python/Makefile's typecheck recipe is now wrapped in selected-run.
reasons.python.unit: python/Makefile's unit pytest line now goes through selected-run with --default test/unit.
reasons.python.verifiable_clients: python/Makefile's test-verifiable-clients recipe (mypy and pytest) is now wrapped in selected-run.
reasons.rust.admin: The admin integration test binary is run by the workspace and all-features cargo test lines that are now wrapped.
reasons.rust.consumer: The consumer integration test binary is run by the workspace and all-features cargo test lines that are now wrapped.
reasons.rust.consumer-perf: A workspace member whose tests run under the wrapped `cargo test --workspace`.
reasons.rust.doc: The doctests run under the `cargo test --workspace` that rust/Makefile now sends through selected-cargo-test.
reasons.rust.ffi-macros: A workspace member whose tests run under the wrapped `cargo test --workspace`.
reasons.rust.generator: test-all-features now runs `-p xtask -p generator` through the new wrapper.
reasons.rust.integration: test-integration and its per-protocol variants now run the integration target through selected-cargo-test.
reasons.rust.lib: rust/Makefile's test, test-all-features and test-integration recipes now run cargo test through the new xtask selected-cargo-test wrapper.
reasons.rust.multilanguage-test-server: A workspace member whose tests run under the wrapped `cargo test --workspace`.
reasons.rust.performance: test-integration-perf now runs the performance target through selected-cargo-test.
reasons.rust.producer: The producer integration test binary is run by the workspace and all-features cargo test lines that are now wrapped.
reasons.rust.verifiable-clients: A workspace member whose tests run under the wrapped `cargo test --workspace`.
reasons.rust.xtask: xtask gains the new test_selection module, a serde_json dependency (Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock) and new subcommands in main.rs.
